closing.summary: Big strengths are magnesium, protein, and usually brings decent fat support, but the biggest weaknesses are low vitamin E, low omega 3, and low protein quality. It is good for bone health, digestion, and heart health because calcium and magnesium gives the bone-health case something to work with, fibre supports digestion and steadier meals, and fibre supports the heart-health side.
